name: Oath of the Ancients
summary: Green knights who protect light, life and beauty.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
features.summary: As an action, spectral vines reach for a creature within 10 ft.: it makes a STR or DEX save (its choice) or is restrained, repeating the save each turn.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
features.short: Turn fey and fiends within 30 ft.
features.summary: As an action, each fey or fiend within 30 ft. that can hear you makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.short: You and allies within 10 ft. resist spell damage.
features.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft. have resistance to damage from spells. The range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.short: Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 once per long rest; you don't age.
features.summary: When you are reduced to 0 hit points and not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once per long rest. You also suffer none of the drawbacks of old age.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.short: Transform: regenerate, cast faster and weaken enemy saves.
features.summary: As an action, you transform for 1 minute: regain 10 hit points at the start of each turn, cast 1-action paladin spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 ft. have disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity. Once per long rest.
